//go:build windows

package main

import (
	"debug/pe"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"time"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

type windowsPlatform struct{}

func init() { newPlatform = func() (platform, error) { return windowsPlatform{}, nil } }

func (windowsPlatform) Preflight() (map[string]any, error) {
	version := windows.RtlGetVersion()
	var processMachine, nativeMachine uint16
	if err := windows.IsWow64Process2(windows.CurrentProcess(), &processMachine, &nativeMachine); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if runtime.GOARCH != "arm64" || nativeMachine != pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_ARM64 || processMachine != pe.IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_UNKNOWN {
		return nil, errors.New("fixture requires a native ARM64 controller on Windows ARM64")
	}
	if version.MajorVersion != 10 || version.BuildNumber < 26100 || version.ProductType != 1 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("fixture requires Windows 11 24H2 or newer workstation; got %d.%d build %d product %d", version.MajorVersion, version.MinorVersion, version.BuildNumber, version.ProductType)
	}
	return map[string]any{"windows_build": version.BuildNumber, "native_machine": nativeMachine, "controller_arch": runtime.GOARCH, "go_version": runtime.Version()}, nil
}

type windowsChild struct {
	process, job          windows.Handle
	input, output, stderr *os.File
	pid                   uint32
	done                  chan struct{}
	result                error
	once                  sync.Once
	finishErr             error
	forced                bool
}

func (p *windowsChild) Input() io.WriteCloser { return p.input }
func (p *windowsChild) Output() io.ReadCloser { return p.output }
func (p *windowsChild) Errors() io.ReadCloser { return p.stderr }
func (p *windowsChild) Done() <-chan struct{} { return p.done }
func (p *windowsChild) PID() uint32           { return p.pid }
func (p *windowsChild) Result() error         { <-p.done; return p.result }

type jobAccounting struct {
	TotalUserTime, TotalKernelTime, PeriodUserTime, PeriodKernelTime int64
	PageFaults, TotalProcesses, ActiveProcesses, TerminatedProcesses uint32
}

func jobActive(job windows.Handle) (uint32, error) {
	var accounting jobAccounting
	err := windows.QueryInformationJobObject(job, windows.JobObjectBasicAccountingInformation, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&accounting)), uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(accounting)), nil)
	return accounting.ActiveProcesses, err
}

func (p *windowsChild) Finish() (bool, error) {
	p.once.Do(func() {
		active, err := jobActive(p.job)
		p.finishErr = errors.Join(p.finishErr, err)
		if err != nil || active != 0 {
			p.forced = true
			p.finishErr = errors.Join(p.finishErr, windows.TerminateJobObject(p.job, 1))
		}
		deadline := time.NewTimer(5 * time.Second)
		defer deadline.Stop()
		ticker := time.NewTicker(10 * time.Millisecond)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		empty := false
		for !empty {
			active, err = jobActive(p.job)
			if err != nil {
				p.finishErr = errors.Join(p.finishErr, err)
				break
			}
			if active == 0 {
				empty = true
				break
			}
			select {
			case <-deadline.C:
				p.finishErr = errors.Join(p.finishErr, errors.New("owned job did not become empty within cleanup budget"))
				goto closeHandles
			case <-ticker.C:
			}
		}
	closeHandles:
		// The unnamed job handle is not inherited. Closing it is also the crash path.
		p.finishErr = errors.Join(p.finishErr, windows.CloseHandle(p.job))
		select {
		case <-p.done:
		case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
			p.finishErr = errors.Join(p.finishErr, errors.New("owned process termination was not confirmed"))
		}
		p.finishErr = errors.Join(p.finishErr, p.input.Close(), p.output.Close(), p.stderr.Close(), windows.CloseHandle(p.process))
	})
	return p.forced, p.finishErr
}

func (windowsPlatform) Start(executable string, args []string, directory string) (_ child, resultErr error) {
	if !filepath.IsAbs(executable) || !filepath.IsAbs(directory) {
		return nil, errors.New("owned process paths must be absolute")
	}
	application, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(executable)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	command, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(windows.ComposeCommandLine(append([]string{executable}, args...)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	workingDir, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(directory)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	job, err := windows.CreateJobObject(nil, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	owned := false
	defer func() {
		if !owned {
			resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, windows.CloseHandle(job))
		}
	}()
	info := windows.JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION{}
	info.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags = windows.JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE
	if _, err := windows.SetInformationJobObject(job, windows.JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&info)), uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(info))); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	childInput, parentInput, err := os.Pipe()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer childInput.Close()
	defer func() {
		if !owned {
			parentInput.Close()
		}
	}()
	parentOutput, childOutput, err := os.Pipe()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer childOutput.Close()
	defer func() {
		if !owned {
			parentOutput.Close()
		}
	}()
	parentError, childError, err := os.Pipe()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer childError.Close()
	defer func() {
		if !owned {
			parentError.Close()
		}
	}()
	handles := []windows.Handle{windows.Handle(childInput.Fd()), windows.Handle(childOutput.Fd()), windows.Handle(childError.Fd())}
	for _, handle := range handles {
		if err := windows.SetHandleInformation(handle, windows.HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, windows.HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	attributes, err := windows.NewProcThreadAttributeList(1)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer attributes.Delete()
	if err := attributes.Update(windows.PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST, unsafe.Pointer(&handles[0]), uintptr(len(handles))*unsafe.Sizeof(handles[0])); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	startup := windows.StartupInfoEx{
		StartupInfo:             windows.StartupInfo{Cb: uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(windows.StartupInfoEx{})), Flags: windows.STARTF_USESTDHANDLES, StdInput: handles[0], StdOutput: handles[1], StdErr: handles[2]},
		ProcThreadAttributeList: attributes.List(),
	}
	var process windows.ProcessInformation
	flags := uint32(windows.CREATE_SUSPENDED | windows.CREATE_NO_WINDOW | windows.CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT | windows.EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT)
	if err := windows.CreateProcess(application, command, nil, nil, true, flags, nil, workingDir, &startup.StartupInfo, &process); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer windows.CloseHandle(process.Thread)
	// Assign before resuming so even immediate child creation remains job-owned.
	if err := windows.AssignProcessToJobObject(job, process.Process); err != nil {
		terminateErr := windows.TerminateProcess(process.Process, 1)
		wait, waitErr := windows.WaitForSingleObject(process.Process, 5000)
		if waitErr == nil && wait != windows.WAIT_OBJECT_0 {
			waitErr = errors.New("unassigned suspended process termination unconfirmed")
		}
		return nil, errors.Join(err, terminateErr, waitErr, windows.CloseHandle(process.Process))
	}
	p := &windowsChild{process: process.Process, job: job, input: parentInput, output: parentOutput, stderr: parentError, pid: process.ProcessId, done: make(chan struct{})}
	owned = true
	go func() {
		wait, err := windows.WaitForSingleObject(p.process, windows.INFINITE)
		if err != nil {
			p.result = err
		} else if wait != windows.WAIT_OBJECT_0 {
			p.result = fmt.Errorf("unexpected process wait result %d", wait)
		} else {
			var code uint32
			if err := windows.GetExitCodeProcess(p.process, &code); err != nil {
				p.result = err
			} else if code != 0 {
				p.result = fmt.Errorf("owned process %d exited with code %d", p.pid, code)
			}
		}
		close(p.done)
	}()
	if _, err := windows.ResumeThread(process.Thread); err != nil {
		_, finishErr := p.Finish()
		return nil, errors.Join(err, finishErr)
	}
	return p, nil
}
